graduate.title: Programming for Biologists
graduate.description: Python and Linux for biological data analysis, including file processing, reusable functions, and debugging. Sequence analysis with Biopython and BLAST; data handling and visualization with NumPy, pandas, and SciPy.

graduate.title: Statistics in Biology
graduate.description: Statistical analysis in R, from experimental design and hypothesis testing to regression and ANOVA. Bootstrap and permutation methods, with attention to model assumptions, uncertainty, and interpretation of biological data.

graduate.title: Genomics of Human Populations
graduate.description: Genomic approaches to population history, migration, and natural selection. Analysis of linkage disequilibrium, population structure, and admixture in R, connecting patterns of genetic variation with evolutionary processes.

graduate.title: Biological Databases & Datamining
graduate.description: Relational database design and SQL queries with MySQL and SQLite. Biological data mining through clustering, classification, and regression, including applications to gene-function prediction and integration of genomic information.

graduate.title: Evolutionary Genetics & Genomics
graduate.description: Critical reading of research on speciation, genome evolution, phylogenomics, and genotype–phenotype relationships. Evaluation of figures and analytical evidence, alongside literature synthesis and scientific writing.

graduate.title: Applied Genomics
graduate.description: Sequencing workflows on Linux and HPC, including SLURM, quality control, alignment, and quantification. An individual pine RNA-seq project on NLR expression, using Salmon/tximport, DESeq2, Mfuzz, and WGCNA, with R Markdown documentation and a Shiny dashboard.

graduate.title: Population Genetics and Evolutionary Biology for Bioinformatics
graduate.description: Comparative and population-genomic approaches to evolutionary questions: phylogenetic reconstruction, orthology, synteny, population structure, and adaptation. Interpretation of genomic variation in studies of traits and disease.

graduate.title: Machine Learning in Medicine and Biology
graduate.description: Predictive modeling for biological and medical data, including regression, classification, decision trees, random forests, support vector machines, and neural networks. Model selection, cross-validation, and assessment of generalization and limitations.
